tabs.content:
// Curated feature-usage table - extracts typed columns from the JSON payload.
.create table FeatureUsage (
    event_id:string,
    event_time:datetime,
    customer_id:string,
    user_id:string,
    product:string,
    environment:string,
    event_type:string,
    feature:string,
    action:string,
    duration_ms:int,
    success:bool,
    error_code:string,
    device_os:string,
    browser:string,
    source_system:string,
    export_format:string,
    row_count:int,
    rating:int,
    tokens:int,
    message:string
)


//Transformation function for update policy
.create-or-alter function SoftwareTelemetryRaw_To_FeatureUsage() {
    SoftwareTelemetryRaw
    | extend payload = todynamic(event_json)
    | project
        event_id,
        event_time,
        customer_id,
        user_id,
        product,
        environment,
        event_type,
        feature = tostring(payload.feature),
        action = tostring(payload.action),
        duration_ms = toint(payload.duration_ms),
        success = tobool(payload.success),
        error_code = tostring(payload.error_code),
        device_os = tostring(payload.device.os),
        browser = tostring(payload.device.browser),
        source_system = tostring(payload.source),
        export_format = tostring(payload.format),
        row_count = toint(payload.row_count),
        rating = toint(payload.rating),
        tokens = toint(payload.tokens),
        message
}

.alter table FeatureUsage policy update
    ```[
        {"IsEnabled": true, 
        "Source": "SoftwareTelemetryRaw", 
        "Query": "SoftwareTelemetryRaw_To_FeatureUsage()", 
        "IsTransactional": true, 
        "PropagateIngestionProperties": true}
    ]```
    
.show table FeatureUsage policy update

FeatureUsage | take 10

.alter-merge table FeatureUsage policy mirroring kind=delta with (IsEnabled=true, TargetLatencyInMinutes=0)

.show table FeatureUsage operations mirroring-status

.show table FeatureUsage operations mirroring-failures

.show table FeatureUsage operations mirroring-exported-artifacts

tabs.content:
// Raw telemetry often contains nested JSON and arrays. KQL can turn that into clean analytical tables automatically at ingestion time.

.create table FeatureUsageTags (
    event_id:string,
    event_time:datetime,
    customer_id:string,
    feature:string,
    tag:string
)

// mv-expand over semi-structured JSON arrays.
.create-or-alter function SoftwareTelemetryRaw_To_FeatureUsageTags() {
    SoftwareTelemetryRaw
    | extend payload = todynamic(event_json)
    | extend tags = payload.tags
    | mv-expand tag = tags
    | project
        event_id,
        event_time,
        customer_id,
        feature = tostring(payload.feature),
        tag = tostring(tag)
}

.alter table FeatureUsageTags policy update
```[
  {
    "IsEnabled": true,
    "Source": "SoftwareTelemetryRaw",
    "Query": "SoftwareTelemetryRaw_To_FeatureUsageTags()",
    "IsTransactional": true,
    "PropagateIngestionProperties": true
  }
]```

FeatureUsageTags | take 10
tabs.title: FeatureUsageTags

tabs.content:
// Most used product features
FeatureUsage
| summarize Events=count(), Users=dcount(user_id), Customers=dcount(customer_id)
    by feature
| order by Events desc

//Feature adoption by customer
FeatureUsage
| summarize 
    Events=count(),
    ActiveUsers=dcount(user_id),
    SuccessfulEvents=countif(success == true),
    FailedEvents=countif(success == false)
    by customer_id, feature
| extend SuccessRate = round(100.0 * SuccessfulEvents / Events, 2)
| order by customer_id asc, Events desc

//Average feature response time
FeatureUsage
| summarize 
    AvgDurationMs=round(avg(duration_ms), 0),
    P95DurationMs=percentile(duration_ms, 95),
    Events=count()
    by feature
| order by AvgDurationMs desc

//Analyze failures from extracted JSON fields
FeatureUsage
| where success == false
| summarize Failures=count() by feature, action, error_code
| order by Failures desc

//Query over free-text messages
FeatureUsage
| where message has_any ("timeout", "failed", "confusing", "unavailable")
| project event_time, customer_id, feature, action, success, error_code, message
| order by event_time desc

//Search for AI-related feedback
FeatureUsage
| where feature == "AI Assistant"
| where message has_any ("confusing", "timeout", "forecast", "summary")
| project event_time, customer_id, user_id, action, success, rating, tokens, message
| order by event_time desc

//Feature tags from JSON arrays
FeatureUsageTags
| summarize Events=count(), Customers=dcount(customer_id)
    by tag
| order by Events desc

.create materialized-view feature_adoption_by_customer on table FeatureUsage
{    
    FeatureUsage  
    | summarize Events=count(),
    ActiveUsers=dcount(user_id),
    SuccessfulEvents=countif(success == true),
    FailedEvents=countif(success == false)
    by customer_id, feature
}
